title: 다락방 시계탑 광장
description: 오래된 다락방 물건들 사이에 세워진 조그마한 시계탑 광장에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
theme: 조그만 것들의 대도시 다락방 시계탑 광장
scene: A charming macro miniature festival square built on the wooden floor of a warm old attic, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. At the center, one oversized open antique brass pocket watch stands upright as the city's clock tower, with a clearly visible round cream clock face without readable numerals and exactly one large turquoise teardrop-shaped pendulum hanging below it. Across the upper-left, a short twine festival garland holds exactly four large, clearly separated coral triangular paper pennants. At the lower-left, a tiny fountain made from three stacked cobalt-blue sewing buttons rises from a shallow silver thimble basin; the topmost button is large and unobstructed. At the upper-right, one prominent brass clockwork winding key is mounted horizontally on a small wooden mechanism, with its two-lobed bow clearly oriented vertically like a figure eight. Near the lower-right, the recurring friendly mouse engineer wears a bright yellow work helmet and carries the same red postal satchel, which has exactly one large gold five-point star buckle centered on its flap. Include thread-spool market stalls, ruler benches, matchbox buildings, folded-paper lanterns without writing, dust motes in warm sunbeams, and a few miniature residents celebrating. Keep the turquoise pendulum, four coral pennants, top blue fountain button, vertically oriented winding-key bow, and gold star satchel buckle large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, or numbers.
style: original premium macro miniature diorama storybook game illustration matching the established Tiny Things teacup harbor, thread station, button garden, and planter jungle stages, warm golden attic window light, shallow but readable depth, tactile brass, aged wood, paper, thread, painted metal, button, thimble, and fabric textures, polished animated-feature background quality, crisp object silhouettes, cohesive warm wood, antique brass, cream, turquoise, coral red, cobalt blue, sunny yellow, and muted lavender palette, not imitating any specific artist or franchise
changeGuidance: Make only these five changes: 1) change only the large turquoise teardrop-shaped pendulum below the central pocket-watch clock tower to coral red while preserving its shape and position, 2) remove exactly one of the four coral triangular paper pennants from the upper-left twine garland so three remain, 3) change only the topmost cobalt-blue sewing button of the lower-left thimble fountain to sunny yellow, 4) rotate only the upper-right brass clockwork winding key's two-lobed bow by 90 degrees from vertical to horizontal while preserving the shaft and mounting mechanism, 5) change only the large gold five-point star buckle on the mouse engineer's lower-right red postal satchel into a gold round buckle of similar size. Preserve the attic, pocket-watch tower, clock face, garland, fountain, thimble basin, winding mechanism, mouse engineer, helmet, red satchel, stalls, buildings, residents, camera, crop, lighting, palette, texture, and every other object exactly. Do not make any additional changes.
